clusters.purpose: Now separate learning from using what was learned. Pretraining teaches a representation from a reconstruction task. sections.explanation: The authors want traffic classification that combines accuracy with efficient processing. The opening claims describe their research contribution.
The authors want traffic classification that combines accuracy with efficient processing. The opening claims describe their research contribution.

Earlier Transformers, Mamba work, traffic representations and long-tailed classification. “Long-tailed” means many examples in common categories and relatively few in others. Table I compares representation choices.

State-space models carry a numerical state through a sequence. Mamba’s input-dependent selection changes how information is retained and used. The continuous/discrete equations explain that mechanism.
Prepare traffic representations, pretrain by reconstructing hidden content, then fine-tune for labels. Dashed boxes identify pluggable components.
Five steps: split flows, parse packets, crop/pad/concatenate bytes, form byte strides, and construct size/time sequences. These steps define what an example means.

Turn inputs into vectors, process them with the encoder, reconstruct missing values during pretraining, and learn categories during fine-tuning. The optional distribution-aware loss changes the treatment of imbalanced classes.
Capture and flow extraction feed a GPU classifier through shared memory; Redis and Flask make results available. These surrounding services are part of the authors’ prototype.
Datasets, baselines, metrics, hardware and hyperparameters define the conditions under which the reported results apply.
